title: BotMachineManageRequest
description: bot.machine-manage-request@1: what a caller changes on a machine (plan L34, step M2). A rename gives a name; a roles change gives the whole set of roles (network.machine-roles-put@1's shape). The same body is what the network's hub sends to Bot, so both sides speak one shape.

name.description: The name the owner gives the machine. Absent when the call changes something else.

roles.description: The machine's roles after the change. Absent when the call changes something else.
